messages:
sylvie: Need a succinct one-pager for execs that ties long-term routing policy work (multi-region + tenant isolation) to concrete customer asks and launch gating. Can someone sketch prioritized initiatives + required signoffs?

omar: I'll sketch. Want priority by "customer value" and "operational risk". High customer value + low risk = fast wins.

kevin: Callouts from sales: per-tenant region pinning, predictable dedicated lanes pricing, and a clear migration path for existing tenants. Customers also ask for an "isolation maturity" ladder (shared -> quarantined -> dedicated).

nina: Ops/infra: must include measurable gates: KV-evac-time SLA, default spill threshold (5%), burst buffer percent, and a post-enable burn-in window. Also require a dark-launch plan for gradual enablement.

sylvie: Draft table below. Keep each row to one line for slides. Mark owners and ETA windows (Q2/Q3/Q4).

sylvie: ```text
Priority rows:
1) Tenant region-pinning — impact: high, risk: medium, owner: omar, ETA: Q2, gate: KMS+contract clause
2) Isolation maturity ladder (shared -> dedicated) — impact: high, risk: high, owner: kevin, ETA: Q4, gate: billing + capacity contracts
3) Soft-spill defaults & opt-in — impact: medium, risk: low, owner: nina, ETA: Q2, gate: telemetry + kill-switch
4) KV-cache evacuation primitives — impact: medium, risk: low, owner: infra, ETA: Q2, gate: runtime tests (<30s P95)
5) Policy-as-code + audit logs — impact: high, risk: medium, owner: platform, ETA: Q3, gate: audit + rollout automation
6) Cross-region QA harness (synthetic failovers) — impact: medium, risk: medium, owner: ops, ETA: Q3, gate: 48h burn-in
```

omar: Add migration notes: existing tenants default to current behavior; new tenants can opt into pinning. Plan a migration API and a manual migration window per tenant.

kevin: Pricing note: include expected unit-cost delta for dedicated lanes (estimate range), and require sales to document customer commitment for capacity.

nina: Dark-launch plan: 1) internal-only simulated traffic, 2) pilot customers with explicit opt-in and test windows, 3) expanded opt-in with telemetry gating, 4) general availability. Each step needs a checklist.

contracts-bot: New draft clause created: contracts/region-pinning-short-clause.md (for legal review)

sylvie: OK. I'll turn this into one slide with the 6-line priority list, a 2-line migration policy, and a 3-bullet dark-launch plan. Final step: owners confirm gates and ETA by EOD. If no objections, I'll mark as agreed and include in the OKR roadmap doc. :white_check_mark:
